0022600145.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-4, on a four-game losing streak, 15th in the West and 3 games back in the Pacific) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (0-4, also on a four-game losing streak, 14th in the West) in this fifth game of the Kings' season. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while New Orleans is missing Yves Missi (knee bruise) and Jordan Poole, who is day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Kings lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2, though Sacramento won the last meeting 117-113 in Sacramento on April 3, 2026.
